lines.text: Point one: the Line is old. Point two: a Dominion contractor wants to replace it with a pump that fills the cisterns in a week.
Point three: the pump empties the aquifer in ten years. The contractor will be somewhere else by then. Keths will not.
Hands. Stone. A choice, and I will not make it for you. Repair the gravity line, sign the pump, or teach three families the Line and step back.
I want to be asked less. That is not on the list.
